title: 4. Proposal record (L)
description:
Shipped story: ship-37026d (Proposals). Size L. Depends on story 3 (votes on any subject, including proposals).

As a reader or AI drafter, I want changes to the map expressed as Proposals, so that steering and editor review happen on a visible record.

Acceptance criteria:
- Proposal kinds: story draft, new concept, rename, merge, split, new column, element symbol.
- States: Draft, In steering, Editor review, Approved, Declined, Overridden by editor; transitions are enforced.
- Drafts are publicly readable and labelled as drafts, and are published via the snapshot.
- Proposals can be voted on using story 3.
- Attribution of machine-written proposals reads AI.
- All behaviour here ships with Gherkin specs (Feature/Scenario/Given/When/Then) in the repo, written first and green before close.
